tagline: The Radiant Guardian of Metro Nova
backstory: Infused with the solar heart of an interstellar flare during an orbital research mission, Marcus returned to Earth as a beacon of unstoppable solar radiance.

powers.name: Solar Beam
powers.description: Channels concentrated solar radiation into a devastating focused beam.
powers.flavorQuote: Taste the brilliance of a thousand suns!

powers.name: Plasma Burst
powers.description: Fires an unstable sphere of superheated plasma that explodes on impact.
powers.flavorQuote: Warning: volatile thermal reaction imminent.

powers.name: Photon Barrier
powers.description: Creates a shimmering hard-light barrier that absorbs incoming attacks.
powers.flavorQuote: Your attacks will not pierce this light.

powers.name: Supernova Genesis
powers.description: Ultimate Power: Gathers cosmic energy and releases a blinding cataclysmic blast.
powers.flavorQuote: Behold the dawn of total victory!

sidekicks.backstory: An eager high-school prodigy with natural electro-kinetic speed. Loyal, fast-talking, and eager to learn.

synergyMove.name: Twin Lightning Barrage
synergyMove.description: Volt Spark dashes behind the target, pinning them with electricity while you strike.

job.description: Analyze cosmic radiation data while secretly calibrating your own solar abilities.

tagline: The Silent Justice in the Dark
backstory: Heir to the Vance Industrial empire, Cassandra trained in martial mastery across six continents to avenge her father and dismantle corruption from the shadows.

powers.name: Shadow Flurry
powers.description: A rapid series of martial arts strikes exploiting weak points.
powers.flavorQuote: Too slow to see it coming.

powers.name: Volt EMP Grenade
powers.description: Hurls an electro-magnetic pulse grenade that scrambles tech and shocks nervous systems.
powers.flavorQuote: System reboot in 3... 2... 1.

powers.name: Smoke Shroud Evade
powers.description: Drops a high-density smoke canister, confusing attackers and bolstering counter-attacks.
powers.flavorQuote: Now you see me... now you don't.

powers.name: Ghost Blade Requiem
powers.description: Ultimate Power: Vanishes into shadow and delivers twelve surgical strikes in the blink of an eye.
powers.flavorQuote: You were already defeated before you turned around.

synergyMove.name: Drone EMP Disruption
synergyMove.description: Deploys a shock drone that stuns the target and shreds 15 armor points.
